enriched_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker, doing routine resident checks, personal care assistance and medication prompts in a residential care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Check resident rooms. Assist resident with personal care. Prompt resident to take medication. Walk to next room. Knock on door. Enter room. Check resident's condition. Record notes on clipboard. Wash hands. Use computer to log entries. Answer call bell. Walk to resident's room. Assist resident to bathroom. Change bed linens. Empty commode. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Document medication time. Report to supervisor. Continue rounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the night shift by train and bus from the care facility to Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Clock out at facility. Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Stand up. Exit train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Pull cord to request stop. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock front door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a quiet light breakfast of toast and fruit with a cup of tea and rinsing the dishes straight away so the kitchen stays clear
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Put bag on chair. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out fruit. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out knife. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place on plate. Spread butter on toast. Cut fruit. Pour tea from kettle into cup. Sit at table. Eat toast. Eat fruit. Drink tea. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Rinse knife. Place in dish rack. Wipe hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and changing out of work clothes after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Remove work clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Hang towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up for daytime sleep: turning on the fan for white noise, closing the curtains, silencing the phone and checking the written reminder list for later in the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Close door. Turn on fan. Close curtains. Pick up phone. Press button to silence. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up written reminder list. Read list. Place list on nightstand. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift in a quiet, dark room with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Pull blanket up to chin. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn onto stomach. Move arm under pillow. Adjust leg position. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Remain asleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Fall back asleep. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking slowly, drinking a cup of tea, rereading written reminders and checking text messages for confirmed plans
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up on bed. Reach for cup of tea on nightstand. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Pick up written reminders. Read reminders. Put down reminders. Pick up phone. Press home button. Open text messages. Read messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Shopping for groceries on foot and by bus, paying in cash and sticking to the weekly budget list
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select vegetables. Walk to aisle. Pick up rice. Pick up lentils. Check list. Walk to checkout. Place items on counter. Pay cash. Receive change. Bag items. Walk out of store. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Ride home. Exit bus. Walk to house. Enter house. Put groceries on kitchen counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a flexitarian dinner of rice, lentils and stir-fried vegetables using the rice cooker and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Take out rice cooker. Measure rice. Rinse rice. Add water. Place pot in rice cooker. Press cook button. Take out lentils. Rinse lentils. Put lentils in pot. Turn on induction cooker. Add water to pot. Boil lentils. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Heat pan on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables to pan. Stir-fry vegetables. Check rice cooker. Rice done. Turn off induction cooker. Serve rice. Serve lentils. Serve vegetables.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with a pot of tea and writing out the next day's written to-do list
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat rice. Eat lentils. Eat vegetables. Drink tea. Put down fork. Pick up pen. Write to-do list for next day. Write tasks. Read over list. Put down pen. Pick up cup. Drink tea. Stand up. Clear plates. Carry plates to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes, wiping down the bench and putting away the dry goods from the grocery run
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Fill sink. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in rack. Wipe bench. Open cupboard. Put away dry goods. Close cupboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a load of laundry in the washing machine and drying the clothes in the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open washing machine door. Load dirty clothes. Add detergent. Close door. Select cycle. Press start. Wait for cycle. Open dryer door. Transfer clothes to dryer. Close dryer door. Select cycle. Press start. Wait for dryer. Open dryer door. Remove clothes. Fold clothes. Carry clothes to bedroom. Put clothes in drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying at the desk on the computer, reading required social work course readings and taking detailed notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open course readings. Read text. Highlight key points. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Read next section. Write more notes. Check time. Continue reading. Write summary. Close notebook. Put down pen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making another cup of tea and taking a short break from study
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water. Add milk. Stir tea. Walk back to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting a written assignment on the computer with the desk lamp on, checking the marking rubric point by point
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Read rubric. Type introduction. Type body paragraph. Check rubric point. Revise paragraph. Type more content. Save document. Check word count. Continue typing. Read over draft. Make edits. Save again. Close document.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the weekly budget, counting cash set aside for rent and bills and updating the paper spending record
enriched_activities.desc: Open desk drawer. Take out budget book. Take out cash. Count cash. Count bills. Write amount in book. Open calculator. Add expenses. Write total. Put cash in envelope. Put envelope in drawer. Close drawer. Put budget book on desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed with the fan on, reading quietly until falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read more. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off fan. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Fall asleep.
